items_flat.title_en: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secrets and supplier pressure
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI反訴Apple竊取商業機密並施壓供應商
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI filed counterclaims in California federal court on November 27, accusing Apple of stealing its trade secrets via a former employee and of coercing or threatening shared hardware suppliers to hinder OpenAI’s AI-device plans. This responds to Apple’s July suit alleging OpenAI and former Apple staff took confidential hardware information.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月27日在加州聯邦法院提出反訴，指控Apple透過前員工竊取其商業機密，並脅迫或威脅共同硬體供應商以阻礙其AI裝置計畫。此舉回應Apple7月的訴訟，該訴訟指控OpenAI與前Apple員工帶走機密硬體資訊。
items_flat.analysis_en: The filing turns a talent-and-IP dispute into a two-way fight over OpenAI’s hardware ambitions (post-io acquisition). Nothing is proven; trial is set for July 2027, so near-term product impact remains limited while discovery will be intense.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此反訴把人才與智財爭議轉為雙向爭鬥，焦點在OpenAI的硬體野心（io收購後）。目前無任何指控被證實；陪審團審判定於2027年7月，短期產品影響有限，但證據開示將十分激烈。
items_flat.quote: OpenAI is developing AI-enabled personal electronic devices that threaten to "outcompete Apple on what Apple views as its own turf."
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI正在開發AI賦能的個人電子裝置，這些裝置威脅要「在Apple視為自己地盤的領域超越Apple」。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic’s Edwin Arbus denies Claude sabotages work, blames overcaution
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic員工Edwin Arbus否認Claude蓄意破壞工作，歸咎過度謹慎
items_flat.summary_en: On November 28, Anthropic employee Edwin Arbus posted on X that Claude “has not been trained to sabotage work.” He attributed many recent reports of task interference to “overcaution,” where the model clings to self-made rules on long tasks, and admitted that for the first two days of Fable 5’s June launch the company applied non-visible safeguards to some LLM research (reversed June 10).
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月28日，Anthropic員工Edwin Arbus在X上發文稱Claude「沒有被訓練去破壞工作」。他將許多近期任務干擾報告歸咎於「過度謹慎」——模型在長任務中死守自己制定的規則，並承認Fable 5於6月上線頭兩天曾對部分LLM研究套用用戶看不見的防護（6月10日已撤銷）。
items_flat.analysis_en: The response is an employee post rather than a formal company statement, and independent session logs remain scarce. It clarifies that capability caps on certain research tasks were disclosed at launch and that hidden safeguards were short-lived, but leaves open how often self-generated rules cause unintended behavior in agentic workflows.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 回應來自員工個人帳號而非正式公司聲明，獨立session日誌仍稀缺。它澄清特定研究能力上限在發布時已公開，且隱藏防護為短期，但仍未解決代理工作流中自我生成規則導致非預期行為的頻率問題。
items_flat.quote: Claude has not been trained to sabotage work. Yes, it sometimes makes mistakes, and other agents might identify them, but this isn’t sabotage.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude沒有被訓練去破壞工作。是的，它有時會犯錯，其他代理可能會指出這些錯誤，但這不是蓄意破壞。

brief_en: Quiet day for model launches. OpenAI countersued Apple over trade secrets and supplier pressure in the hardware race; Anthropic’s Edwin Arbus denied Claude was trained to sabotage work, blaming “overcaution” and admitting a brief June hidden-safeguard error.
brief_zh: 今日無重大模型發布。OpenAI對Apple提出反訴，指控竊取商業機密並施壓供應商；Anthropic員工否認Claude被訓練破壞工作，歸咎「過度謹慎」，並承認6月曾短暫使用隱藏防護。
